text: 在2026世界机器人大会开幕式上，工业和信息化部副部长辛国斌在致辞中介绍，2025年，机器人产业规模以上企业营业收入突破3000亿元，近五年年均增速超20%；今年上半年达到1655亿元，同比增长24.5%。
text_en: At the opening of the 2026 World Robot Conference, Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology Xin Guobin noted that in 2025, robot industry revenue from enterprises above designated size exceeded 300 billion yuan, with average annual growth over 20% in the past five years; in the first half of this year, it reached 165.5 billion yuan, up 24.5% year-on-year.
